name: יְרִיָּהוּ
gloss: Yahweh teaches; or Yahweh has laid (founded)
summary: A Levite of the sons of Hebron, son of Kohath, head of his house in David's ordering of the Levites (1Ch 23:19; 24:23), and, spelled יְרִיָּה, the head of the Hebronites in David's fortieth year, among whom were found men of valour in Jazer of Gilead (1Ch 26:31); TIPNR lists the two places as two men. The name is the verb יָרָה with the divine name: “Yahweh teaches” (the hiphil, as in Psa 25:8, “he teaches sinners in the way”) or “Yahweh has laid” (the qal of laying a cornerstone, Job 38:6). Scripture does not say which.

evidence.note: “The sons of Hebron: יְרִיָּהוּ the head, Amariah the second.”
“Good and upright is Yahweh; therefore he teaches (יוֹרֶה) sinners in the way.”

note: Takes j.di.aj (3 tokens: יְרִיָּהוּ twice, יְרִיָּה once). TIPNR keys Jeriah@1Ch.23.19 (with 1Ch 24:23) and Jerijah@1Ch.26.31; both are tagged, as both bear the name. The vowel of יְרִי- matches neither the qal (יָרָה) nor the hiphil (הוֹרָה) exactly; both readings are of the root only.
